unmapped_findings: At 950 °C and 0.1 s^-1, the DRX fraction-vs-time curve reaches 1.0 (full recrystallization) near 7 s (Fig. 6b).
The cylindrical specimen (φ6 mm × 9 mm) was cut along the rolling direction from hot-rolled round bars and polished to facilitate welding of the thermocouple.
Tantalum foil 0.1 mm in thickness was placed between the specimen ends and the indenter to prevent interfacial melting and to minimize friction.
Table 2 (constant conditions) reports model accuracy: flow stress RMSE 4.8944 MPa, R² 0.9909, AARE 3.91%; load RMSE 274.6820 N, R² 0.9918, AARE 6.65%.
The material is mainly applied for the production of automobile hub bearings and was provided in the form of hot rolled round bars.
